verdict.rationale: Docs confirm signed (HMAC) webhooks, dashboard/API management, and a documented resend/replay capability, plus idempotent retries for API calls generally. However, evidence lacks detail on automatic retry policy for webhook deliveries specifically, structured event logs beyond resend, or a full replay/audit UI, and no independent/hands-on corroboration is present. missing for 10: documented automatic retry schedule for webhook deliveries, detailed event log/audit trail UI, independent verification of replay reliability.
